title: Promise states

blocks.promptMd: Can a fulfilled promise become pending again?
A fulfilled promise can become pending again.
blocks.explainMd: Pending, then fulfilled or rejected. The state does not go backward.

blocks.promptMd: > `label()` must return a Promise (e.g. `Promise.resolve("locked")`), not a bare string. Print the fulfilled value.

hintLadder.md: Use `Promise.resolve("locked")`, then print the value from `then`.
The desk already stamped locked. You only need to read the slip.

description: A promise is pending, kept, or broken. It does not change again.
